notes.title: New Patch Live Now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722259/b1d31100c8dc9089face7c2449784d8f3cf5feb7.jpg

Our latest update brings a host of thrilling enhancements and content additions:

Toggle Enemy BS Animation
•	Now, the enemy battle sequence animation is switched off for faster, smoother gameplay experience!

DLC Expansion
•	If purchased, Nichole's Home Brew is now available in all maps of the free DLC "To Danse with Ravenous Shadows".

Expand your Brain
•	Customize your character even further with increased perk tree capacity from 30 to 36, offering more freedom in skill development.

Introducing - New Perks that unlock three new ally companions.
•	Barbarian Battle Buddy
If there is room in your party, a mighty Barbarian joins you in battle! Uses a Battleaxe, Bull Rush, Fart Escape.

•	Amazing Wizard's Apprentice
If there is room in your party, a powerful Wizard joins you in battle! Using a Staff, Gravity Bomb, Bubble Shield, and a Bullshit Power.

•	Tactical Tree Hugger
If there is room in your party, a crafty Ranger joins you in battle! Uses Bow & Daggers, Drones, Snowball Turrets.

Optimizations & Balancing
•	Enjoy smoother gameplay with several bug fixes, optimizations, and balance improvements for a better, more refined experience!
•	DLC update: Nichole’s Horns are now unlocked correctly when all chapters are completed with two Brews active.
•	Issues that caused loss of progress were fixed.

notes.title: Two New DLCs for SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! Available Today!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44722259/d14e7bd6c4eb5e6fd026f5a549df9d1e81a003dd.png

Two New DLCs for SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! Available Today on All Platforms

Vienna, Austria - October 23, 2024: THQ Nordic is excited to announce the release of two new DLCs for SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! - Nichole's Home Brew and Good Times with Weapons - Weapon Variation Pack. Available now on Nintendo Switch™, PlayStation®5, Xbox Series S|X, and PC. Watch both trailers now:

Nicole's Home Brew: https://youtu.be/xGjfPZAfMV0
Good Times with Weapons - Weapon Variation Pack: https://youtu.be/MWPeiwqwoIg

Nicole's Home Brew
Nichole’s Infernal Pacts were just the beginning! The Board Girls have unleashed diabolical new Home Brew rules for Snow Day, featuring game-altering modes like The Floor is Lava, Air Superiority, and Super Pissed Off. These brutal challenges will push you to your limit. Your gear? Useless. Your strategies? Obsolete. Adapt fast or fail. Conquer all five new modes and unlock even crazier rule combinations to prove you’re the one and only New Kid. Are you ready?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3223240

Good Times with Weapons - Weapon Variation Pack
Harness the power of speed and stealth and follow the path of the Ninja with the all-new Ninja Stars ranged weapon variation. Strike quickly with a decisive burst of projectiles and vanish back into the shadows, for the life of a Ninja is complex and full of peril. This DLC features an all-new weapon variation of the Wand: the Ninja Star ranged weapon. It also includes three brand-new upgrade cards and new cosmetics.

 Hat: Ninja Hat
 Facial Features: Ninja Mask
 Tunic: Ninja Tunic
 Hat: You're a dog!
 Facial Features: Ninja Star to the Eye
 Emote: Ninja Star Emote


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3126400

Both DLCs are part of the Season Pass and the Digital Deluxe Edition
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717700/SOUTH_PARK_SNOW_DAY__Season_Pass/
https://store.steampowered.com/sub/976991/

notes.title: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/3f9cd16e0af10d7dd075f181eb6076128580bf34.png

SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY!, Latest Game From The Award-Winning South Park Franchise, Available Today!
 
Vienna, Austria - March 26, 2024: It's a snow day – the most magical of days! South Park Digital Studios & THQ Nordic GmbH today released SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! The latest game from the award-winning South Park franchise is now available for Nintendo Switch™, PlayStation®5, Xbox Series S|X, and PC.

Get the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1214650/SOUTH_PARK_SNOW_DAY/

The game comes with a free DLC, adding the game mode "To Danse With Raveno" at release, which adds more playtime, variety and challenge inbetween the main story acts. School is cancelled and Henrietta is bored. Join her efforts to pierce the veil and she will allow you to “Danse with the Ravenous Shadows” of South Park. Face waves of dark foes, upgrade your weapons, and master more dark powers to earn new cards from Henrietta. This new game mode provides an endless onslaught of enemies and enhance your dark powers.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2777700/

Continue your Snow Day adventures with a Season Pass for SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! which includes an all-new Game Mode, New Weapons, a Weapon Variation, and Cosmetic Packs. The Season Pass is included with the Digital Deluxe Edition.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2717700/

This Season Pass includes 6 DLCs in total: 

 All-new Game Mode: This all-new Game Mode changes the rules again! Prepare for hellish, new rules and special challenges that make Nichole’s “Infernal Pacts” feel like kindergarten recess.
 All-new Ranged Weapon and New Cosmetics: The Snowball is perfect for all those who mastered the other ranged weapons in the game. Unleash devastating new attacks on enemies and grant powerful supporting effects on your allies.
 All-new Melee Weapon and New Cosmetics: A new Melee Weapon will be announced later this season.
 New Weapon Variation for the Daggers: This Weapon Variation will give the Daggers a devastating overhaul, replacing some of the weapon upgrade cards with crazy new powers that open up completely new play styles and tactics.
 CRED Cosmetic Pack: A kid today is defined by their hydration drink – and their swag. Impress your friends and show the world how much CRED you have. The CRED Cosmetic Pack gives you plenty of CRED with a fresh hairstyle, a CRED hoodie, and a cape.
 Asspen Cosmetic Pack: An “Asspen” themed Cosmetic Pack featuring new jackets, hats, and more will be available later this season.


For more info visit: www.southparksnowday.com


Check out the release trailer here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AINsLcZ7-hk

SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY!, developed by Question and published by THQ Nordic GmbH in cooperation with South Park Digital Studios, is available now. The Standard Edition of the game is available at an SRP of € 29.99 / $ 29.99 / £ 24.99. The Digital Deluxe Edition is available at an SRP of $49.99 / €49.99 / £39.99. 

The hit animated franchise South Park, which celebrated its 25th anniversary in 2022, is available on Comedy Central with exclusive events on Paramount+ including SOUTH PARK: POST COVID, SOUTH PARK: POST COVID: THE RETURN OF COVID, SOUTH PARK THE STREAMING WARS, SOUTH PARK THE STREAMING WARS PART 2, SOUTH PARK: JOINING THE PANDERVERSE and the recently released SOUTH PARK (NOT SUITABLE FOR CHILDREN). 

Building on MTV Entertainment Studios’ expansive deal with co-creators Matt Stone and Trey Parker, South Park has been renewed on Comedy Central through 2027, taking cable’s longest-running scripted series through an unprecedented 30th season.
